summary: Enhance your leadership by understanding and implementing empathy and compassion in the workplace, with our Leading with Empathy and Compassion Training Course.
lede: An empathy at work course helps leaders and people managers address team conflict, build trust and balance compassion with clear performance expectations. It develops practical skills in emotional self-regulation, psychological safety, active listening and de-escalation, while covering inclusive decision-making, burnout warning signs and feedback practices for hybrid and digital teams.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for leaders who operate at the intersection of human capital and operational delivery.
modules: Neuroscience of Empathy and the SCARF Model
Empathy in Hybrid and Digital Workflows
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals in leadership or management roles. While there are no formal prerequisites, you should have at least two years of experience managing teams or cross-functional projects. You should come prepared with a real-world leadership challenge or team conflict scenario to use during the practical workshop sessions. Familiarity with basic performance management cycles is recommended.
